oneLineSummary: Quaternion/sedenion algebra = group action on Lie group (CompoundE 2024). Cayley-Dickson construction iterated: ℝ→ℂ→ℍ→𝕺→𝕾 (16D). Der(S)=Der(O)=G₂ (14D exceptional Lie algebra). ICE_ORCA_DRAGON sedenion 분석과 KGE RotatE/QuaternionE algebraic isomorphism 확립 가능. Quaternion KGE = Hamilton product scoring; sedenion KGE = potential S₁×S₁×S₁ + 제약된 nonassociative extension.
rootCause: Quaternion/sedenion 타입 구조와 KGE embedding space가 동일한 group action algebra 세계관에 속함. RotatE (S¹)ⁿ rotation group + CompoundE affine group unification이 quaternion ℍ⁴ / sedenion 16D와 동일 공리계 안에 있음. Cayley-Dickson 구성이 자연스럽게 KGE 차원 확장과 대응.
recommendation: 1) ICE_ORCA_DRAGON 기존 sedenion G₂/SU(2)/SU(3) 임베딩 분석 유지. 2) 별도 축 신설: A4::S2 = 'Quaternion KGE Formalization' (Lean Mathlib `Quaternion` type + scoring function formal spec). 3) A4::S3 = 'Sedenion-to-KGE Isomorphism Proof' (CHU entity embedding ↔ sedenion element, relation composition ↔ sedenion multiplication). 4) PROM_16_REPORT.md에서 CompoundE+RotatE+QuaternionE 세 모델의 group action taxonomy 통합 제시. 5) 후속 APT 진입: apt-st (Contract: SedenionKGEScoring := sedenion_mult ∘ entity_lift), apt-scw (TDD red: sedenion_mult_assoc_failure @ S₁×S₁×S₁×S₁). 6) KG: 기존 lesson-prom64-chu-internet-binding-2026-04-29 와 orthogonal; 새 Lesson 노드 생성 lesson-prom16-quaternion-sedenion-kge-isomorphism-2026-04-29.
alternatives: Pure hypercomplex embedding (DualE / HyperQuaternionE on Poincaré ball) — 하지만 Lie group action 명시성 손실, CHU rank (PageRank analog) 와의 연결 약화
TransE-only baseline (skip quaternion) — 간단하나 2D rotation 한계로 intra-relation asymmetry 미포착, mass_ratio derivations(S₁~S₇) 과의 기하학적 정렬 불가능

Sedenion full embedding without truncation (16D KGE) — 이론적으로 pure이나 parameter explosion (entity N 개 × 16 floats), practical training instability (nonassociativity zero divisor 문제), sparsity-sensitivity 증가
caveats: 1) Lean Mathlib `Quaternion` type 있으나 sedenion formal library 미성숙 (arXiv 2505.11747 논문 수준, Lean 형식화 아직 없음). 2) CompoundE 2024 group action 통합이 이론적이지 실제 sedenion 16D KGE 구현 없음. 3) ICE_ORCA_DRAGON 기존 python 분석은 numerical (multiplication table, G₂ group computation) — Lean formal verification 수준 아님. 4) KGE zero-divisor 처리: sedenion 16D에는 zero divisors 다수 (nonassociative algebra의 결과), KGE scoring 안정성 미확인. 5) Cayley-Dickson 각 단계 associativity/alternativity 손실: ℂ=assoc+alt, ℍ=assoc (no alt), 𝕺=alt (no assoc), 𝕾=neither → KGE 구성 시마다 formal assumption change required.

evidence: CompoundE 2024 proves KGE = group action; quaternion ℍ = Cayley-Dickson level 2 ⊂ affine group
RotatE (S¹)ⁿ closure property directly analogous to sedenion multiplication closure (except zero-divisors)
QuaternionE (arXiv 1904.10281) Hamilton product h⊗r≈t already extends RotatE from S¹ to ℍ
ICE computations show Der(S) = Der(O) = G₂ = 14D exceptional Lie algebra; KGE embedding spaces routinely 14D+ (Facebook entity embedding 500D typical)

Zero divisors: sedenions include a,b with a⊗b=0 but a,b≠0; scoring function becomes degenerate
CompoundE proof assumes associative group; sedenion breaks that
